We are building solutions for 600+ public organizations in the Nordics, and our AI platform runs customer deployments at scale and is evolving fast with GenAI and agentic AI. As Senior AI Cloud Architect, you own the cloud architecture for our AI platform and shared services. You will define reference architectures, make key technology choices (Microsoft-first, but open), and ensure security, reliability, and automation as we scale. What You Will Do Design and evolve the target architecture for a public-cloud-first AI platform (Azure preferred). Exploration of alternative deployment strategies for high-security customers Build secure, compliant foundations: landing zones, identity, networking, encryption, secrets, logging, and policy-as-code. Architect for scale and automation: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, GitOps, self-service environments, and operational runbooks. Own platform reliability: observability, SLOs, incident patterns, performance, and cost optimization (FinOps). Define patterns for AI product integration: APIs, event-driven processing, data pipelines, and multi-tenant considerations. Partner with AI engineers/data scientists on MLOps and LLMOps: model delivery pipelines, feature stores, evaluation, and monitoring. Drive security and Trustworthy AI practices together with security, privacy, and product teams (GDPR and data residency aware). Support solutioning and pre-sales when needed, and mentor architects/engineers across product teams. What You Bring Senior – 8-10+ years of relevant experience, including service or solution architecture in complex product environments. More junior profiles will be considered in case of relevant experience – not the time but the type of experience and responsibility is important to us. Strong public cloud architecture skills (Azure: AKS/Container Apps, Functions, App Service, API Management, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Storage, SQL/Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Entra ID). Experience with multiple deployment scenarios and high security requirements is a plus Hands-on experience with automation: Terraform and/or Bicep, CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), and modern deployment practices. Proven security architecture skills: threat modeling, zero trust, network segmentation, secrets management, vulnerability management, and audit readiness. Experience building or operating AI/ML platforms: Azure ML/MLflow, model serving, data pipelines, and LLM integration patterns. Ability to translate business needs into pragmatic architectures and communicate clearly with both engineers and stakeholders. Nice to have Experience with GenAI platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI) and guardrails: content filters, prompt injection defense, red teaming, and evaluation. Knowledge of data engineering components: Databricks/Spark, Delta Lake, data streaming, and search/vector databases. Certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Security Engineer, or similar. Impact you will have Own the reference architecture for our cloud-first AI platform supporting AI capabilities for public organizations in the Nordics. Raise the security and compliance baseline with zero-trust patterns, policy-as-code, and audit-ready controls. Increase delivery speed and consistency through automation: self-service environments. Improve reliability and cost efficiency with SLO-driven operations, observability, and FinOps practices. Tech we use Azure-first and automation-driven: containers/Kubernetes, serverless, messaging, IaC (Terraform/Bicep), CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub), observability, and cloud security tooling. We are open to AWS/GCP experience. Review and implementation of defined improvements of automation framework and pipelines in place for core platform services. Operational excellence established: dashboards, SLOs, alerting, and incident playbooks used in day-to-day operations. Security and Trustworthy AI governance embedded: threat models, risk assessments, and guardrail patterns for GenAI use cases. Why join us Build technology that improves citizen services - with real-world scale and meaningful impact. A highly skilled, collaborative environment with room to influence architecture decisions end-to-end. Modern cloud-first stack, strong focus on security and responsible AI, and freedom to explore new approaches (including agentic AI). Professional growth, international collaboration, and a culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership. Practicalities Location and work setup: flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen or Espoo). Fluent English required; Nordic language skills are a plus. Are you our new colleague? We look forward to hearing from you! If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Geir Are Bjørnsrud (geirare.bjornsrud@tietoevry.com) Additional Information At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Deine Aufgaben: Aufbau, Systemwartung und Abbau von SUSE Linux Enterprise Server und Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server auf x86_64-, sowie IBM Power-Hardware nach ITIL-Prozessen Incident Management (2nd Level Support), Change Management und Problem Management (3rd Level Support) Patchmanagement und Verwalten von Servern mit SUSE Multi-Linux Manager und Red Hat Satellite Aufbau, Systemwartung und Abbau von HighAvailability-Cluster auf Basis Corosync/Pacemaker Automation von Arbeitsschritten/-prozessen mittels Ansible/Ansible Automation Platform Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Optimierungsmaßnahmen Unterstützung bei Erstellung von Sicherheitsvorgaben Change, Release und Configuration Management Dein Profil: Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes IT-Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung Min. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich der Linux-Administration (SuSE Linux Enterprise Server und RedHat Enterprise Linux Server) im Rechenzentrumsumfeld Erste Berufserfahrung in der Konzeptionierung, dem Aufbau, sowie Betrieb von Linux-HighAvailability-Systemen (Corosync/Pacemaker) auf IBM-Power (vorzugsweise in Verbindung mit SAP-HANA) Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Automation mittels Ansible / Ansible Automation Platform Solide Kenntnisse in Bash-Skripting sowie in den Programmiersprachen, z.B. sed, awk, python ITIL-Zertifizierung von Vorteil Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Wir bieten: Durch abwechslungsreiche und gesellschaftlich relevante Aufgaben gewährleisten wir den reibungslosen IT-Betrieb und die Digitalisierung der Bundeswehr Das Ziel eint uns. Dabei sind für uns ein wertschätzender Umgang miteinander sowie ein großer Teamgeist elementar Wir bieten 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, 1 Brauchtumstag plus Optionen auf individuelle Anpassungen Über unsere Benefit-App erhält man ein monatliches Guthaben und kann sich zusätzlich Steuervergünstigungen auf Tickets für den ÖPNV sichern Wir ermöglichen Flexibilität, um Beruf und Privatleben in Einklang zu bringen, etwa durch mobiles Arbeiten oder Vertrauensarbeitszeit Wir unterstützen die berufliche und persönliche Weiterbildung durch individuelle Maßnahmen sowie einen kostenfreien Zugriff auf LinkedIn Learning Unser Jobradangebot ermöglicht das Leasing von bis zu 2 Fahrrädern Die Einstiegsvergütung liegt im Regelfall zwischen 51.300 € und 66.200 € brutto p.a. Die konkrete Höhe wird basierend auf Kriterien wie z.B. Qualifikation, Verantwortungsbereich und den Anforderungen der Position festgelegt. Gerechtfertigte Abweichungen sind im Einzelfall möglich
